title: Execution of the multiplication procedure
statement: Let $a,b,c,x$ be finite bit strings with $x=\langle a,\langle b,c\rangle\rangle$, and let $j\le |a|+|b|$. Let $v$ be a vector of thirteen natural-number registers, each at most $4(|x|+1)$, satisfying $v_1=|x|$, $v_2=2|a|+2$, $v_4=2|a|$, $v_5=2|a|+2+2|b|$, and $v_6=|a|+|b|$. Suppose also that $v_7=j$, $v_{11}=K_j$, and $v_{12}=2|a|+2+2|b|+2+\min(j,|c|)$, where $K_j$ is the carry into column $j$ for multiplying $a$ and $b$. The fixed multiplication procedure, started in its column-processing state with registers $v$ and no answer yet, halts with the Boolean value of the following condition: $|c|\le |a|+|b|$, $K_{|a|+|b|}=0$, and for every $i$ with $j\le i<|a|+|b|$, the $i$th bit of $c$ equals $(K_i+C_i(a,b))$ modulo $2$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is the specified nested pair encoding of $a,b,c$
$v$ is a vector of thirteen natural-number registers
The specified equalities for registers 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6 hold
Register 11 equals the carry into column $j$
